shots.title: EXP-43 run 3: the grid made 54 by 54 tiles (the editor still draws the map's own 36 by 36)

marks.text: the squad starts here, as in run 2; the pieces by it are run 2's
an abductor wall on the new ground, east of the old edge: it stands on ground, gives full cover, breaks
a dry bush on the new ground, north-east: low cover
the far corner of the new grid (dashed outline): the cursor, the camera and a soldier's path reach it
